Instrument (EN): Reproductive Grief Screen / RGCare5 — 2026 patient-preferred five-item wording research edition
Scales / measured domains (EN): Same single candidate complicated-reproductive-grief screening construct, revised item-language acceptability across three alternatives for three of five questions. No new independent subscale validation, scoring algorithm, sensitivity/specificity, or cross-language invariance in this item-wording study.
Research provenance: Mattson et al., Nursing for Women's Health 2026, electronically reported 2026-07-03, October 2026 print issue; DOI10.1016/j.nwh.2026.04.004. Institute notes clinical validity Phase4 under review and tool release anticipated 2027.
